set_week_program.name: Set week program
set_week_program.description: Writes heating times and temperatures to the week program of a HomeMatic thermostat (e.g. HM-CC-RT-DN). All selected days are sent in a single radio transmission.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Thermostat(s) whose week program is changed.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: Instead of the device: the thermostat's climate entity.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Slots with end time and temperature, the last one ends at 24:00. As a list [{end: '06:00', temp: 17}, …] or as short text: "06:00 17; 22:00 21; 24:00 17".

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Week profile (1–3 on the HM-CC-RT-DN). Default: the first profile.

activate.name: Activate profile
activate.description: Make the given profile the active one afterwards.

get_week_program.name: Get week program
get_week_program.description: Returns the week program of a HomeMatic thermostat as a response.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: Instead of the device: the thermostat's climate entity.
